title: Infrared rehearsal result (sandbox output)
description: The sandbox's output: traffic profile used, failure(s) injected, measured availability and latency before/during/after the failure, pass/fail against the forecast's min_availability_pct. Every measurement carries its provenance (synthetic on Floci). The orchestrator passes this to the dashboard and uses the pass/fail verdict to decide whether to loop back or proceed to approval.

schema_version.description: Semver major.minor. Additive changes bump minor; anything that removes/renames/retypes a field bumps major.

candidate_id.description: Which candidate/layout was rehearsed, from result.json.

forecast_id.description: The forecast this rehearsal was checked against.

traffic_profile.description: The traffic pattern sent to the infrastructure during the rehearsal.

pattern.description: constant = steady requests/s; ramp = linearly increasing; burst = spikes; diurnal = time-of-day curve.

duration_s.description: Total duration of the traffic generation in seconds.

target_endpoint.description: The ALB or entry point URL that received the traffic.

requests_per_second.description: Request rate for constant pattern, or base rate for others.

total_requests.description: Total number of requests sent across all phases.

failure.description: The single failure injected during the rehearsal.

type.description: instance_stop = EC2 instance stopped; task_stop = ECS/EKS task stopped; zone_down = entire AZ fails; network_partition = network cut; resource_exhaustion = CPU/memory spike.

target_component.description: Component id (from infra.json) that the failure was applied to.

injected_at_s.description: Seconds from the start of the rehearsal when the failure was injected.

detail.description: Additional details about the failure (which instance, which zone, etc.).

phases.description: Measurements broken into three phases: before the failure (baseline), during the failure, and after recovery.

status.description: healthy = component stayed up; degraded = partial failure; failed = component went down.

verdict.description: Pass/fail decision against the forecast's min_availability_pct.

passed.description: True if measured availability meets or exceeds the forecast's minimum.

measured_availability_pct.description: The overall availability measured during the rehearsal.

gap_pct.description: Shortfall (negative) or excess (positive) vs the threshold.

infrastructure.description: Details about the infrastructure built for this rehearsal.

components_created.description: List of component ids successfully created.

teardown_status.description: Whether all resources were torn down.

provenance.description: observed = real metrics from the system; estimated = computed; synthetic = fake data (Floci).

basis.description: How the value was obtained, e.g. 'CloudWatch metric' or 'HTTP probe'.

phase_measurement.description: Measurements for one phase of the rehearsal.

requests_total.description: Total requests sent during this phase.

requests_failed.description: Requests that failed or timed out.
